Gain the confidence you need and communicate effectively in the demanding healthcare career of your choice.

Medical English courses develop general English speaking and listening skills with 1-to-1 Medical English.

The 1-to-1 Medical English lessons will focus on your individual needs, taking into account your specific line of work.

Medical English courses are suitable for doctors, nurses, dentists, pharmacists, students of medicine and other professionals working in the medical sector.

・improve general and social English language skills and your pronunciation
・enhance your communication skills for dealing with English-speaking patients and colleagues
・raise awareness of intercultural issues and ‘international English’
・develop specific vocabulary and expressions for English used in the medical sector
・practice giving presentations in English or taking a patient history, if necessary
・ work on writing medical reports, emails or case studies · taking a medical history
・conducting physical examinations
・breaking bad news · dealing with problematic patients
・effective patient handovers
・Study language associated with a range of medical situations
・Learn specialized terminology
・Focus on interpersonal skills relevant to your field.

If you are a healthcare professional or university student and you want to improve your English language skills in a context relevant to your career, this is the course for you.

For those working in a medical field, it is important to be highly accurate and clear in their communication but they also need to be able to show tact and sensitivity.
During the course, you will develop these English language skills in a variety of contexts.
This will help you increase your confidence when communicating with patients and their families as well as with colleagues.

pro_course_detail.title: Preparation for IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
***This class is NOT for children under 16 years old***

Taking an IELTS exam can be lifechanging and daunting, in equal measure! 

In an IELTS preparation lesson we will practice the speaking and writing parts of the exam - parts 1, 2 and 3 of the Speaking test, and Tasks 1 and 2 of the Writing exam.

We will look at:
- what exactly you need to do in order to achieve the band score you require;
- useful exam tips to increase your understanding and confidence; and
- vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation 

We can practice under timed conditions if you wish, working towards a mock exam eventually. 

For IELTS lessons, I refer regularly to British Council materials (I attend monthly IELTS teachers' webinars run by the British Council) as well as various text books and several IELTS websites which provide useful resources. I will also provide you with multiple resources for independent practise, and an ongoing record of what we cover together. 

ALL my IELTS students have gone on to achieve the band score they wanted or higher!

pro_course_detail.title: British English for communication: general conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
***Please note this class is NOT for children. If you want to book classes for your child please choose my British English for Kids lesson***

I am an outgoing person - I love meeting people, and I am quite a chatterbox in my day-to-day life! In these lessons, we will choose a topic and chat at length about it. We can use newspaper articles, videos and social media to stimulate conversation, and of course, you are welcome (and I actively encourage you) to choose a subject which is particularly interesting to you. I will ask questions about your opinions and reasons, creating lots of opportunities for you to communicate and explain your personal ideas about all kinds of things, ranging in complexity. 

The aim of these lessons is to get you comfortable and confident with communicating (i.e., conveying meaning) in English more effectively, so I will provide feedback on pronunciation errors only when they affect the clarity of the meaning. Similarly, I will give you feedback on grammar if there are serious mistakes which make it difficult to understand. This approach allows more time and space for you to practice developing fluency. I usually make notes during class, so we can go over the details of any grammatical errors later, rather than interrupting your flow. 

I am a natural, strong communicator, and I find I can often instinctively understand what my students are trying to express, even when they struggle to find the right words. I will offer suggestions of alternative vocabulary, idioms or colloquial expressions that might be more commonly used in spoken English, which will help your communication feel and sound more natural. 

I am British, and these lessons will include everyday British idioms, sayings and expressions, and where relevant, my personal insights into and reflections on British culture. They will be useful for anyone who wants to communicate with British people in general, but particularly helpful for anyone immigrating to the UK.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing correction / proofreading
pro_course_detail.description:
I will provide comprehensive correction and feedback comments on a wide range of writing, including but not limited to: 
- university essays, dissertations, theses 
- IELTS Task 1 and Task 2 essays, both general and academic
- work emails, reports, presentations
- CVs, job applications
- online content - websites, LinkedIn profile, social media / video captions

THIS CLASS IS OFFLINE AND DOES NOT REQUIRE PHYSICAL ATTENDANCE
To book this service, please book the class then contact me to email the documents. 
As I have a busy schedule, please ensure you allow A MINIMUM of 48 hours to correct your work. 

You will receive:
An edited document showing any spelling mistakes, grammar mistakes and typos;
Changes and suggestions to improve clarity, coherence and cohesion, structure and readability;
Tracked revisions so you can see and review all the changes/suggestions that have been made; 
Formatting suggestions, if applicable; and
A brief analysis of how well your writing achieves the requirements set out in the Public Band Descriptors for IELTS, if applicable. 
**Please note that it is NOT allowed for teachers who are not accredited IELTS examiners to give band score predictions, therefore I cannot give you a band score**

PLEASE CHECK THE WORD COUNT OF YOUR DOCUMENT(S) BEFORE BOOKING.

Up to 500 words - 30 Minutes
500 - 1000 words - 1 hour
1000 - 2000 words - 1.5 hours

I’ll help you develop strategies to improve task response, coherence, cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical accuracy. Each lesson is tailored to your level and specific goals, whether you aim to elevate your score to Band 6.5 or progress further. You will receive comprehensive feedback and targeted guidance to enhance your writing style and overall performance.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic English

We will work on enhancing your academic writing, including essay structure, critical analysis, and the use of formal academic language. Special attention will be given to improving your ability to write clear, coherent arguments, conduct literature reviews, and cite sources correctly.

I’ll also help you master the nuances of academic vocabulary and grammar, ensuring you can express ideas precisely and effectively. Each lesson is personalized to address your specific academic goals, whether you’re preparing for university assignments or looking to improve your overall academic writing. You’ll receive constructive feedback and practical strategies to advance your writing proficiency and academic performance.

Each lesson is tailored to your specific needs and professional context, whether you're looking to enhance your job interview performance, improve business correspondence, or refine your overall communication skills.

Through targeted feedback and structured practice, you’ll gain the confidence and fluency needed to succeed in a global business environment.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description: For students who want to improve their general English skills, courses are tailored to your requirements and level, focusing on the four skills, reading, writing, speaking and listening. Also I will try to improve your vocabulary and pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation and Vocabulary Booster
pro_course_detail.description: Increase your confidence in speaking by increasing your vocabulary. We would have conversations including a variety of common topics. For each topic I would supply you with some vocabulary materials to study before and during the lesson, so that you can practise using the new words in conversation.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS preparation
pro_course_detail.description: We will focus on the writing and speaking parts of the IELTS exam together. In the lessons we will practice mock tests of the the speaking parts and I will give you IELTS related vocabulary topics to study so you can boost your vocabulary range before your test.  I will require that you produce written homework for each lesson so we can read your essays and go through your mistakes together. I will provide you with resources so that you can self study the listening and reading parts of the exam.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Offline Proofreading (email only)
pro_course_detail.description:
Offline proofreading of  your IELTS task 1 and task 2 practice essays. I will return them with corrections, comments and an estimated band score based on the rubrics available on the IELTS website. **TWO TASKS PER HALF HOUR**
Also **Please note, this is for me to proofread your essays offline**

pro_course_detail.title: Interview practice
pro_course_detail.description: Interview preparation lessons, for job interviews, university interviews etc. We will go through common interview questions together so you can work on answering the questions confidently and accurately. I will give feedback regarding the grammatical accuracy, vocabulary, pronunciation etc. as well as feedback on the content of your answers and advice on how to approach some of the common questions.
